lesson: Avoid long momentum breakouts in a risk‑off market unless VWAP and trend are firmly above; exit earlier if momentum turns negative.
For shorts, use tighter stops or a counter‑news filter to avoid being held while the market rallies.
Implement a volatility filter (ATR > X%) before taking new positions to reduce whipsaw losses.
Never open short positions on stocks with extreme oversold RSI levels (< 25) due to high bounce risk.
Avoid taking opposing long and short trades on the same stock within the same intraday session.
Do not open long catalyst or momentum positions when the stock is trading below VWAP.
Avoid re-entering a ticker on the same day if a previous position was manually closed due to broken momentum.
Do not submit new buy orders after 15:30 to adhere strictly to team risk guidelines and avoid EOD execution blocks.
Do not go long when price is below VWAP without a clear reversal signal
Use volatility‑based stops (e.g., 1.5×ATR) to improve risk‑reward
Apply a market‑regime filter – limit new entries when QQQ is down >0.5%
Do not short high-liquidity mega-caps like AAPL or MSFT on news alone without a clear technical breakdown; they are prone to sharp squeezes.
Never take a long position on a stock breaking below its opening range in a risk-off market; this contradicts the regime filter and leads to immediate stop-outs.
Relative strength entries require the stock to be above VWAP and holding that level for at least 15 minutes before entry to avoid buying into a temporary spike.
